name: Booker Lyle
action: Signs the courier clipboard without reading the top invoice.
thought: Wes is eyeing the safe again. He thinks he's quiet.

speech.text: Put the brassware in back. Don't leave it out.

name: Wes Doyle
action: Stashes the heavy padlock key under the cash tray.
thought: He knows I'm watching the numbers. Let him sweat.

speech.text: Courier said the second box is running twenty minutes late.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: Wipes down the leather armrests with diluted disinfectant.
thought: The fine hurt, but the shop's still standing this morning.

speech.text: Grab that fresh stack of towels from the dryer, sweetheart.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Kicks a chunk of broken brick into the weeds.
thought: Kohl's badge won't protect him once the zoning clears.

name: Sgt. Hal Brennan
action: Rubs his temples while reviewing Kohl's shift request.
thought: Two years. I just need two quiet, boring years.

speech.text: Yolanda, let the boy do the route. Paperwork first.

name: Cal Serrano
action: Places canned goods on the shelf with heavy thuds.
thought: Empty house tonight. Errol looks worse than I do.

speech.text: You drop another crate, Errol, boss will dock you.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: taps the corner of Lyle's file against her desk
thought: Hal acts like the paper will file itself if we wait long enough.

speech.text: Did you pull the registry on Lyle’s side business yet, Hal?

name: Cass Deveaux
action: picks up a box of tea without looking at Kohl
thought: He smells like rain and panic, standing two inches off my back.

speech.text: You hovering for a specific reason, Officer, or just practicing patience?

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: tenses up in line, staring straight ahead
thought: Smooth bastard thinks he owns the sidewalk and the till.

speech.text: Buying tea isn't a crime yet, Deveaux. Step up or move along.

name: Booker Lyle
action: slides bills into the register tray one by one
thought: Auditors can look through the ledger until their eyes bleed; cash is cash.

speech.text: Make sure that back latch is oiled before you leave today, Wes.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: closes a manila folder and wipes down the counter
thought: Another quiet hour before the rain pushes the cuts through the door.

speech.text: We're down to two boxes of suture kits, Doctor.

name: Odette Ferreira
action: misaligns three cans of beans on the low shelf
thought: Cal always stacked them face front so nobody had to turn them around.

name: Sticks
action: pulls his damp collar tight against the drizzle
thought: Chidi sits quiet when he wants to hear the street move.

speech.text: Cruisers took the long turn down Delmar twice before the rain started.

event: Elias Reyes finds the count is short again. Not by much. Enough.

name: Elias Reyes
action: pushes his green beans around with a fork.
thought: Jonah thinks he runs this table just because he is bigger.

speech.text: Stop taking up half the bench, Jonah.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: stares fixedly at the television screen without blinking.
thought: Nia sitting at my table acting like she owns the quiet.

speech.text: Volume too loud for you, Nia, or just the company?

name: Dot Feeney
action: rubs her swollen ankles and watches the hallway.
thought: My feet ache more than this entire block is worth.

speech.text: If you are staying, Brennan, keep your boots off the rug.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: turns his tumbler slowly against the damp napkin.
thought: Booker is waiting for me to name an impossible number.

speech.text: Delmar is changing hands whether you like the paperwork or not.

name: Booker Lyle
action: sets down his glass with a heavy clink.
thought: Cass thinks a tailored coat makes a city deed stick.

speech.text: Paperwork is the only thing keeping the marshals off your neck.

name: Nia Nakamura
action: sets her fork down gently on the plate edge.
thought: Rey wants an argument so he does not have to think.

speech.text: The noise is fine, Rey. It is the sour look.

name: Amara Bello
action: leans back against the sofa arm, watching Tee.
thought: Tee sits there like the fine did not cost us half the week.

speech.text: We open at eight tomorrow, Tee. No porch cuts.
